newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: HERMIS TO ISSUE 8 MLN LITAS OF GDRS.
newsitem.headline: HERMIS TO ISSUE 8 MLN LITAS OF GDRS.

text.p: Lithuania's second-largest bank Hermis Bankas said on Friday that it has decided to issue eight million litas of its shares to an investor which will distribute them as global depository receipts (GDRs).
The shares are the remaining portion of a 23 million litas new share issue, most of which was bought by current shareholders.

"The board of Hermis Bank decided to distribute the remaining shares with a face value of eight million litas in a closed way, according to a contract with the investor," the bank said in a statement although it did not name the investor.
"The investor took on the obligation to issue global depository receipts, on the basis of the shares acquired, and to distribute them," the statement said.
Hermis Bank decided to boost its share capital to 90 million litas from 67 million litas in February.
Hermis Bank is one of the leaders on the country's banking market and one of the blue chips on the bourse.
The bank posted 27.4 million litas audited net profit in 1996 and said that its net profit in the first five months of the year was 13.8 million litas.
The bank's assets were 701 million litas, its loan portfolio was 348 million litas and deposits 503 million litas at end May.
